high_level_description: This image is a screenshot of an Instagram post from the account "luciodirosa." The post features a woman standing in front of a window with a decorative, geometric pattern. The window has a white frame and is divided into multiple panes. The background includes a cityscape silhouette and some abstract designs. The woman is wearing a striking, royal blue, strapless dress with a textured, sequined or beaded fabric that gives it a shimmering effect. She is also wearing black high-heeled sandals and large, dangling earrings.
